headline: Home prices post
*first drop since 2023*
slides.fig_caption: U.S. median sale price, October 2026 vs. a year earlier
slides.sub: The median sold for $388,634, the first annual decline since May 2023.

slides.label: of October sales had at least one *price drop*
slides.body: That's the highest share in Redfin's records. 61% of homes sold below their original list price, and 14.9% of pending deals fell out of contract.

slides.title: Buyers *pull back*
slides.note: U.S. pending sales are the lowest since 2013, excluding April 2020, while active listings are at their highest since early 2020.

slides.label: Chicago's median sale price vs. a year ago, to *$378,669*
slides.body: Prices still rose in more than half of the 50 most populous metros. Chicago's active listings are down 2.0% from last year.

slides.title: Price it right *on day one*
slides.body: Supply is building and buyers are cautious with rates averaging 7.33%. Lean on fresh local comps, set expectations early, and prep sellers for negotiation. Price trends vary by metro, so know your market.
